Name: Faedew - A ReShade Preset
Author: rosenfey
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/FcCxtER.png[/img]﻿

I adore Stardew but I prefer a more toned-down, cozy look, hence this reshade preset.
[b][color=#f4cccc]Desaturates the vanilla game and includes colour editing to make the
game look warm and vibrant while avoiding a washed-out effect.[/color][/b]
[size=2]
[/size][size=2][i]Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12019]Back to Nature[/url]﻿ preset but I wanted to make something
that not only desaturates the game but also alters the colours
for a more cozy look.[/i][color=#f4cccc]
[/color][/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oEnVcwg.png[/img]﻿
[font=Arial][color=#f9cb9c][b][font=Arial]
[/font][/b][/color][b][font=Arial][b]RESHADE INSTALLATION:[/b][/font][/b][color=#f9cb9c][b]

[/b][/color][color=#f4cccc][b]i. ﻿Download the latest ReShade from[/b] [url=https://reshade.me/#download]here[/url]﻿.

[b]ii. Run the installer and when prompted choose Stardew Valley.[/b][/color][i]

[/i][/font][font=Arial][b][color=#f4cccc]iii. Select OpenGL. [/color][/b][/font][font=Arial][color=#f9cb9c]

[/color][color=#f4cccc][b]iv. Install the shader resources.[/b][/color][color=#f9cb9c][b]
[/b][/color]Make sure you have these effects installed:
• SweetFX by CeeJay
• qUINT by Marty McFly
• Color effects by Prod80
[font=Arial][b][color=#f4cccc]note:[/color][/b] Y[i]ou might want to untick the [b][size=2][size=2]Reshade_HDR_shaders[/size][/size][/b] as it has been reported to give out shader compilation errors.[/i][/font]

⊱ ---------------------------- ⊰[b]

PRESET INSTALLATION:[/b]
[b]
[color=#f4cccc]i. Download the preset and [/color][/b][color=#f4cccc][b]drag the .ini file into your Stardew Valley root folder.[/b][/color]
[i].../steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley[/i]

[color=#f4cccc][b]ii. In-game, press the HOME key to open ReShade, then
[/b][b]pick the Faedew preset from the drop-down menu[/b][b].[/b][/color]
[i]you're done :3

[/i][font=Arial]⊱ ---------------------------- ⊰[/font][i][font=Arial][b]
[color=#f4cccc][/color][/b][/font][/i][/font][/center]
